Information Sheet for Public Meeting of Council
                              Tuesday, February 3, 2026

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The City of Charlottetown has received a proposal to establish a Business Improvement
Area (BIA) in the West Royalty Business Park and the BioCommons Research Park.

Representatives from the West Royalty Business & Bioscience Inc., have proposed the
establishment of a new Business Improvement Area (BIA) covering the West Royalty
Business Park and BioCommons Research Park. The proposed BIA would represent over
75 businesses across more than 150 acres and would focus on coordinated infrastructure
improvements, shared services, business attraction/retention, and unified advocacy.

The City of Charlottetown’s BIA Bylaw provides the legal authority and framework to
establish and regulate a Business Improvement Area (BIA). As a result, the City must
follow the bylaw’s formal establishment process, including public notice, a public
meeting, and an opportunity for feedback from affected businesses and property
owners.

On January 22, 2026, 42 letters were mailed to businesses and property owners within
the proposed BIA boundary, providing notice of the Public Meeting and information on
how to submit feedback or express interest in participating.

As of Friday at 4:00 PM, January 30, 2026, no letters of support or objection regarding
the proposal were received. Written submissions, comments and feedback were
encouraged to be forwarded to biafeedback@charlottetown.ca, 902-629-4000 or City of
Charlottetown, P.O. Box 98, 199 Queen Street, Charlottetown, PE C1A 7K2.

Written submissions will still be received up until Friday, February 6, 2026 and will be
made part of the public record.

             NOTICE OF PUBLIC MEETING
                    DATE & TIME: Tuesday, February 3, 2026 at 6:00 pm
                    VENUE: Council Chambers, City Hall, 199 Queen Street

Charlottetown City Council will hold a Public Meeting to hear comments from business owners and residents
regarding the proposed establishment of the West Royalty Business & Bioscience Business Improvement Area.

A Business Improvement Area (BIA) is a defined geographic area in which local businesses work together to
enhance and promote their commercial district. With the approval of City Council, a special levy is collected on
the commercial assessment within the area and may be used by the BIA to fund improvements such as
marketing and promotion, streetscape enhancements, events, and other initiatives that support business
development.

Those interested in participating in the Public Meeting are encouraged to contact the City of Charlottetown by
4 p.m. on Friday, January 30, 2026 by email at biafeedback@charlottetown.ca or by phone at 902-629-4000, to
provide their contact information (name, phone number, and/or email address). City staff will contact registered
participants by noon on February 3 with details on how to participate in the meeting.




Written submissions are also welcome. Comments may be emailed to biafeedback@charlottetown.ca or mailed
to: City of Charlottetown, P.O. Box 98, 199 Queen Street, Charlottetown, PE C1A 7K2

All written submissions must be received by Friday, Feb. 6, and will be made part of the public record.

West Royalty Business & BioScience Inc. (WRBB)
Proposed Geographical Business Improvement Area (BIA)
